title: Research on electrochemical chiral sensors constructed based on the intrinsic chiral characteristics of AuNPs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13951-13959
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01303H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuping Zhu, Yong Yan, Ruo Yuan, Haijiao Xie
Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations were used to create a gold nanoparticle/graphene oxide/thionine nanocomposite, which was used to modify the surface of a gold electrode for the recognition of D/L-phenylalanine.
